name: Região de Turismo do Algarve (visitalgarve.pt)

why.basis: robots.txt allows all (an access rule, not a reuse licence); but the agenda has no feed and no server-rendered list, and no terms page was found

notes: eventos.visitalgarve.pt (the events guide, 'Guia de Eventos', built by Autarquia 360) read 18 Nov 2026: robots.txt allows all; the home page and an event page are an empty React shell (about 1.2 kB, 'You need to enable JavaScript'); /sitemap.xml and /feed return the same shell; its data comes from a private POST API (api.visitalgarve.pt/website/Travelplanner/Search/Events) whose robots.txt was unreachable and whose terms were not found. Not used. www.visitalgarve.pt/robots.txt redirects (301) to visitalgarve.pt. Event links on it (eventos.visitalgarve.pt/en/<id>/<slug>) stay as evidence only. Ask Região de Turismo do Algarve for a feed or iCal.
